using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Http;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TextGeneration;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.HuggingFace
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Provides a text generation service using the Hugging Face API.
    /// </summary>
    public class HuggingFaceTextGenerationService : ITextGenerationService
    {
        private readonly Uri _endpoint;
        private readonly string? _apiKey;
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
        private readonly ILogger _logger;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="HuggingFaceTextGenerationService"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="model">The name of the Hugging Face model.</param>
        /// <param name="endpoint">The endpoint URL for the text generation service.</param>
        /// <param name="apiKey">The API key required for accessing the Hugging Face service.</param>
        /// <param name="httpClient">The HttpClient to use with this service.</param>
        /// <param name="loggerFactory">The logger factory to use with this service.</param>
        public HuggingFaceTextGenerationService(
            string model,
            Uri? endpoint = null,
            string? apiKey = null,
            HttpClient? httpClient = null,
            ILoggerFactory? loggerFactory = null)
        {
            _endpoint = endpoint ?? new Uri("https://api-inference.huggingface.co/models/" + model);
            _apiKey = apiKey;
            _httpClient = httpClient ?? new HttpClient();
            _logger = loggerFactory?.CreateLogger<HuggingFaceTextGenerationService>() ?? new LoggerFactory().CreateLogger<HuggingFaceTextGenerationService>();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="HuggingFaceTextGenerationService"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="endpoint">The endpoint URL for the text generation service.</param>
        /// <param name="apiKey">The API key required for accessing the Hugging Face service.</param>
        /// <param name="httpClient">The HttpClient to use with this service.</param>
        /// <param name="loggerFactory">The logger factory to use with this service.</param>
        public HuggingFaceTextGenerationService(
            Uri endpoint,
            string? apiKey = null,
            HttpClient? httpClient = null,
            ILoggerFactory? loggerFactory = null)
        {
            _endpoint = endpoint;
            _apiKey = apiKey;
            _httpClient = httpClient ?? new HttpClient();
            _logger = loggerFactory?.CreateLogger<HuggingFaceTextGenerationService>() ?? new LoggerFactory().CreateLogger<HuggingFaceTextGenerationService>();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generates text based on the provided prompt.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="prompt">The prompt to generate text for.</param>
        /// <param name="maxTokens">The maximum number of tokens to generate.</param>
        /// <param name="temperature">The temperature to use for generation.</param>
        /// <param name="topK">The top K tokens to consider for generation.</param>
        /// <param name="topP">The top P tokens to consider for generation.</param>
        /// <param name="numReturnSequences">The number of return sequences to generate.</param>
        /// <returns>A task that represents the asynchronous operation.</returns>
        public async Task<string> GenerateTextAsync(
            string prompt,
            int maxTokens = 100,
            double temperature = 0.7,
            int topK = 40,
            double topP = 0.95,
            int numReturnSequences = 1)
        {
            using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, _endpoint);
            request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", _apiKey);
            request.Content = new StringContent(
                "{\"inputs\": {\"prompt\": \"" + prompt + "\", \"max_tokens\": " + maxTokens + ", \"temperature\": " + temperature + ", \"top_k\": " + topK + ", \"top_p\": " + topP + ", \"num_return_sequences\": " + numReturnSequences + "}}",
                Encoding.UTF8,
                "application/json");

            using var response = await _httpClient.SendAsync(request);
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            var responseBody = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
            var generatedText = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<GeneratedTextResponse>(responseBody);

            return generatedText.generated_text;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Represents a generated text response from the Hugging Face API.
    /// </summary>
    public class GeneratedTextResponse
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the generated text.
        /// </summary>
        public string generated_text { get; set; }
    }
}
